subject: general
question: In May 2025, India assumed the chairmanship of which regional organisation focused on productivity enhancement?

options.text: Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC)
South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Asian Productivity Organization (APO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Asian Productivity Organization (APO) is an **intergovernmental regional organization established in 1961** to promote productivity growth in the Asia-Pacific region.
 
• India assumed the chairmanship of the APO in May 2025 as part of its commitment to enhancing productivity and fostering regional cooperation.
